const s = $input.first().json; const eur = n => '\u20ac ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('nl-NL', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2}); const statusKleur = { PASS:'background:#e1f5ee;color:#0f6e56;', REVIEW:'background:#faeeda;color:#854f0b;', FATAL:'background:#fcebeb;color:#a32d2d;' }; const statusLabel = { PASS:'Goedgekeurd', REVIEW:'Review', FATAL:'Actie nodig' }; function kpi(label, waarde, kleur) { return `

${waarde}
`; } function heatKleur(p){ if(p===0)return 'background:#e1f5ee;color:#0f6e56';if(p<=25)return 'background:#fef3c7;color:#854f0b';if(p<=50)return 'background:#fed7aa;color:#9a3412';return 'background:#fca5a5;color:#7f1d1d'; } // KPI 1 als mail-veilige balk const balkKleur = s.doelGehaald ? '#0f6e56' : (s.handmatigPct <= 60 ? '#854f0b' : '#a32d2d'); const gaugeBalk = `
